docs.title: FocusPulse Core Positioning & Differentiators
docs.body:
## Target Audience
Indie makers, designers, and remote engineers who feel overwhelmed by heavy project-management tools and just want a calm daily timeline.

## Key Differentiators
- **Drag-to-Block**: Drag any task straight onto the calendar timeline with haptic snapping.
- **Two-Way Apple Calendar & Reminders Sync**: Zero account sign-up required; 100% private via iCloud.
- **Focus Live Activity**: Dynamic Island countdown with gentle end-of-block chimes.

## Pricing Model
- Free tier: Unlimited tasks, basic calendar view.
- Pro ($4.99/mo or $39.99 lifetime): Multi-calendar sync, recurring time blocks, macOS menu bar companion.

docs.title: FlowStep Product Brief
docs.body:
## What It Solves
Checklists tell you *what* to do, but when you're tired you still skip steps. FlowStep guides you one focused card at a time with optional timers and floating macOS mini-window.

## Popular Use Cases
- Morning & evening routines
- App Store release submission checklist
- Video recording & pre-flight equipment check

contents.title: FocusPulse 2.4 Launch Thread: Control Center Quick Focus
contents.body:
Shipped FocusPulse 2.4 today!

Biggest friction with time blocking: opening an app just to start a timer.

Now you can swipe down Control Center and start a 25-min focus block in 1 tap — synced live to your Mac menu bar.

Built as a solo indie dev with zero tracking & 100% iCloud sync.

contents.title: I added Control Center widgets & a weekly focus heatmap to my local-first time-blocking app
contents.body:
Hey r/iOSProgramming! Over the past two weeks I refactored my WidgetKit timelines to support iOS 18 Control Center toggles for FocusPulse.

Happy to share how I handled shared App Group SQLite access between the main app, Live Activity, and Control Center extension without deadlocks.

contents.title: 独立开发者的发版前检查清单：怎么避免每次提审都漏细节
contents.body:
以前每次给 App 提审，总会漏掉某一项：不是忘了更新英文截图，就是忘了测恢复购买。

后来我用 FlowStep 做了一套「iOS 发版 SOP」，每次发版前按步骤浮窗一步步打勾，10 分钟走完所有检查项，再也没被打回过。
